record.question: For entering data for discharge analysis, detailed data is entered on the worksheet through separate entries for each patient discharged on the work sheet. This method is known as:
record.explanation: Answer D: Individual entry. Recording a detailed worksheet entry separately for each discharged patient is the individual-entry method. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
